changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6b item 3: folded TeamRuntimeRegistry and TeamWorktreeCleanup into TeamCollection (service/team/index.ts), and moved team.state event publishing ownership from TeamStore to TeamService. TeamCollection now holds one Map<teamId, {service, subscription}> (replacing the old cache/materialized/closedSubscriptions split) plus one constructing map, with create/get/rebuild/startSchedulers/startWorkflows/recoverWorkflows/closeWorkflowAdmissions/stopSchedulers/stopForHost as direct methods; the standalone TeamWorktreeCleanup class is gone, replaced by a private settleClosedWorktree(teamId) method exposed to each TeamService through a new settleWorktreeCleanup constructor-supplied callback on TeamServiceDeps (not a module import, matching the store<-service<-collection direction). TeamRosterProjection.publish() now calls DispatcherCoreEventPublisher.publish() directly instead of going through TeamStore.publishRosterState(); a new TeamRosterProjection.publishTeamState() lets TeamService's own updateRecord()/createNew() publish the team.state aggregate on every status transition, reading the roster it already holds live instead of asking a callback to resolve one from disk. TeamStore lost its coreEvents/roster constructor options and its four publish* methods; its persistence methods (teamRoot/handle/get/list/create/update) and TeamRecord's JSON shape/validation are unchanged. roster-reader.ts's readTeamRoster is deleted (no remaining caller once TeamService always has a live roster to publish from). The team.state event's shape, timing relative to the record write, and content are unchanged — only which class performs the publish moved.
